department: Richard A. Rula School of Civil and Environmental Engineering (Bagley College of Engineering)

deadline.value: The Ph.D. in Civil Engineering is reviewed for Fall on March 15.
deadline.quote: all campuses for the Doctor of Philosophy in Engineering with a Civil Engineering Concentration (Ph.D.) degree program are reviewed three times a year, March 15 for Fall semester admission

gre_general.value: GRE is required unless the bachelor's is from an EAC/ABET-accredited civil, construction or environmental program; no minimum score is set.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are required for all applicants who do not have an EAC/ABET-accredited civil, construction, or environmental engineering degree.

supervisor.value: Admission requires a faculty member in the applicant's sub-discipline who will serve as major professor.
supervisor.quote: Admission requires that the applicant be accepted by a faculty member in their sub-discipline area who is willing to serve as their major professor.

entry_route.value: Regular admission needs a bachelor's or master's in civil engineering (or a related degree).
entry_route.quote: Regular admission requires that the applicant have a Bachelor of Science (B.S., Master of Science (M.S.), or Master of Engineering (M.E.) in Civil Engineering.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

funding.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.

notes: Covers the Engineering PhD with Civil Engineering concentration; the department's March 15 review date replaces the college's June 1 date. Its lower TOEFL 69 and IELTS 6.0 figures apply to contingent admission, so they were not recorded as the regular minimum.
name: Doctor of Philosophy in Engineering (Civil Engineering concentration)
